forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {回|まわ}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to turn, to revolve, to rotate
definitions.explanation: To move in a circular motion around an axis or center.

definitions.gloss: to go around, to make rounds
definitions.explanation: To visit multiple places in succession.

definitions.gloss: to go via, to take a detour
definitions.explanation: To reach a destination by an indirect route.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive). Pair: ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (transitive, to turn something). Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{回|まわ}る (X turns/goes around).

ASPECT: て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing action. {回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'is turning/going around.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦ぐるぐる→ぐるぐる：05160_guruguru⟧{回|まわ}る (spin around)
- ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}る (visit stores)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{回|まわ}る (go around the perimeter)
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{回|まわ}る (head spins; can think clearly)
- ⟦{血|ち}→血：01659_chi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{回|まわ}る (blood circulates)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回|まわ}る (intransitive): X turns
- ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (transitive): turn X

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}→回転：00141_kaiten⟧ (rotation—noun)
- ⟦{一回|いっかい}り→一回り：noentry⟧ (one round, one lap)
